text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: paging @channel - High error rate detected on inference path: /v1/generate (5xx spike). Alert ID: ALERT-502-GEN-2093. Rolling window: 5m.

Ops Bot: automatic mitigations kicking: prefix cache warmup disabled, traffic route weight change +10% to fallback-model-small. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/502-rate-spike

Alex V: i'm on it. quick snapshot: errors ~= 2.1% of requests globally, spike concentrated in eu-west1 (~4.8%). latency also up by ~120ms p50.

Mira Chen: primary/secondary for next 8h? i'm primary through 07:00 UTC, sam is secondary. alex can stay shadowing for first 30m.

Samir Patel: noted. i'm remote until 03:30 UTC but available on pager. coverage gap 02:00-03:00 UTC due to scheduled maintenance by infra team — infra already informed. prefer to have tess cover if this persists past 02:00.

Tess Ramos: i can take that window if needed. ping me on pager.

Alex V: current mitigations in progress: 1) ramp fallback-model-small weight to 30% for eu-west1 only. 2) enable short-circuit caching for repeated prefixes for high-QPS routes. 3) rollout quick patch to rate-limiter rules to relax a recently-strict token limit.

Samir Patel: i'm running quick checks:
```
# check pod restarts and cpu/mem in eu-west1
kubectl -n inference get pods -l region=eu-west1 -o wide
kubectl -n inference top pods --containers --use-protocol-buffers
```
I also see a throttle pattern on tokenstore: 503s coming from tokenstore-proxy.

Mira Chen: customer impact: 6 customer orgs reporting errors via support, highest severity is one enterprise customer with >15% of their requests failing. Legal/CS informed. No P1 yet but could escalate.

Alex V: temp mitigation plan: a) keep fallback-model-small at 30% until 10:10 UTC, b) pin heavy traffic customers to dedicated route (route-id: routing-dedicated-enterprise) for the duration, c) increase prefetch cache TTL to 5m for common prompts.

Samir Patel: i pushed an env change to tokenstore-proxy to increase connection pool from 50->150 in staging. if that looks good we can mirror to prod. will monitor for new errors.

Mira Chen: runbook excerpt for oncall reference: Steps 1-6 -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/502-rate-spike#steps (short version):
- identify region and model variant;
- shift traffic to fallback or smaller quantized variant;
- check tokenstore connectivity + redis backpressure;
- enable short-circuit caching and KV-prefetch;
- notify CS if >10% requests failing for any org;
- if >30m unresolved, escalate to eng-ml + infra.

Alex V: observed logs (eu-west1 tokenstore-proxy):
```
2026-03-14T01:07:12Z tokenstore-proxy[fd3] WARN connection pool exhausted
2026-03-14T01:07:13Z tokenstore-proxy[fd3] ERROR upstream request failed: 503
2026-03-14T01:07:13Z model-server[aa1] ERROR failed to fetch token: upstream 503
```

Samir Patel: patch applied to tokenstore-proxy in prod (hotfix) at 01:12 UTC; replicating pool bump across eu-west1 nodes now. monitoring.

Tess Ramos: i'm watching the support queue and will Triage any new tickets that look P1. currently no new P1s.

Mira Chen: handoff notes for next shift (for whoever takes over):
- Primary: Mira Chen until 07:00 UTC; Secondary: Samir Patel until 07:00 UTC.
- Coverage gap 02:00-03:00 UTC -> Tess Ramos will cover if spike persists.
- Active alerts: ALERT-502-GEN-2093 (generation 5xx spike), ALERT-TOKEN-POOL-2093 (tokenstore pool exhaustion).
- Mitigations in place: fallback-model-small 30% eu-west1, tokenstore-proxy pool bumped, short-circuit caching enabled, prefetch TTL increased.
- Next steps: keep fallback weight, watch error rate; if errors drop <0.5% for 15m, can start gradual rollback of fallback weight; if error rate stays >2% for 30m escalate to eng-ml.
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/502-rate-spike (follow full checklist).

Alex V: please add any logs/graphs you think are helpful to this thread. i'm staying on for another 20m then handing to Mira.

IncidentBot: acknowledged. Pager status: Alex V oncall A (active). Escalation policy: eng-ml on-call will be paged if ALERT-502-GEN-2093 persists >30 minutes.

Mira Chen: acked. i'll take over at handoff. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
